name: Adyta PDA faction & Patchkin art reference pack

policy.provenance: User-supplied prior art; original files preserved in originals.
policy.official_vs_unofficial: Faction posters are concept campaign material; Patchkin imagery is maker/Sideways material. Neither changes official rules, maps, identities, or governance.
policy.text: All source slogans, labels and claims are baked into the images. For UI render authoritative text via HTML/data, not extracted graphic text.
policy.image_crops: Web optimized full sheets are safe to use as visual references. Rough-crop stickers have rectangular black backgrounds and should receive proper masks if used as production die-cut art.
policy.integration: Place this archive at the repository root; these relative art paths resolve under art/pda-v1/imports/. Do not modify canon/data to match artwork. Bump sw.js after integration.
